title: Rebellion crisis LIVE: Only 3 Shiv Sena (UBT) MPs attend key Delhi meet, show-cause notice likely to 6 others
description: Rebellion crisis LIVE: Only 3 Shiv Sena (UBT) MPs attended the key meeting in New Delhi amid speculations of a split within the party. The Shiv Sena (UBT) is likely to issue show cause notices to all six MPs, HT has learnt.
